message:
Format this below message for Slack formatting. Add numbered bullet points

Hey team — quick update on the Q4 billing migration before Thursday's sync. We finished moving 1,840 of the 2,100 enterprise accounts to the new invoicing service over the weekend; the remaining 260 are blocked on the tax-ID validation bug that Priya is fixing (ETA Wednesday). Finance flagged that the October credit notes didn't sync to NetSuite for 37 accounts, so Marco is re-running the export tonight and will confirm by 10am. Support saw a spike in "duplicate charge" tickets (64 since Monday) — all of them were preview invoices, not real charges, and we've added a banner on the billing page to say so. Release freeze starts Friday 6pm IST, so anything that needs to ship has to be merged by Friday noon. Also, the dunning emails are still going out from the old sender address; Arjun owns switching that over. Please reply in thread if you're blocked or if your team's accounts are in the remaining 260. Thanks all!

Hola equipo: actualización rápida del lanzamiento. Ya migramos 1.840 de las 2.100 cuentas empresariales; las 260 restantes dependen del error de validación del NIF que está corrigiendo Priya (lo tendrá el miércoles). Finanzas detectó que las notas de crédito de octubre no se sincronizaron con NetSuite en 37 cuentas; Marco vuelve a lanzar la exportación esta noche y confirma antes de las 10. El congelamiento de versiones empieza el viernes a las 18:00, así que todo lo que deba salir tiene que estar fusionado el viernes al mediodía. ¡Gracias a todos!
